name: Waycen
tagline: Real-time AI-assisted lesion detection for colonoscopy
problem: Colorectal cancer rates in Vietnam are rising quickly, while a shortage of specialist endoscopists and inconsistent early-lesion detection rates leave early-diagnosis infrastructure weak.
value_summary: Waycen provides a real-time AI-assisted colonoscopy solution that helps detect lesions and improves the accuracy and consistency of physician diagnosis.
vietnam_fit: Aligned with the Ministry of Health's early cancer-screening expansion policy, enabling remote reading support for provincial hospitals and helping close the healthcare gap.
target_buyer_display: Seeking partnerships with major general hospitals and local healthcare institutions. Matching inquiries via KICC HCMC.
